subject: history_social
notes: Shandur Pass is in northern Pakistan, between the Chitral and Gilgit regions.
At about 3,700 meters above sea level, it has one of the highest polo grounds in the world.
Every summer, teams from Chitral and Gilgit play polo there during a festival.
Thousands of visitors camp near the polo ground to watch the matches.
stem: The student wants to introduce the Shandur polo festival to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Every summer, teams from Chitral and Gilgit play polo at a festival at Shandur Pass in northern Pakistan.
choices.B: The festival's matches are played each summer between teams from the Chitral and Gilgit regions.
choices.C: At about 3,700 meters above sea level, the ground at the pass is one of the highest polo grounds in the world.
choices.D: Thousands of visitors camp near the polo ground every summer to watch the matches.

explanation.why: A reader who has never heard of the festival needs to learn what it is and where it takes place. Only one choice explains that it is a summer polo festival, names Shandur Pass, and says the pass is in northern Pakistan.
explanation.A: Correct. It tells a new reader what happens (a polo festival), who plays (teams from Chitral and Gilgit), and where (Shandur Pass in northern Pakistan).
explanation.B: Incorrect. It refers to "the festival" as if the reader already knew which one, and it does not say where the matches are played.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This gives an interesting fact about the height of the ground, but it never names the pass or says that a festival takes place there.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This mentions the visitors but never says what is being watched or where, so a new reader learns little about the festival.
